turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have until 4:40, Hale. Owen found out about a zero on his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me. Who decided that, and when?
Owen talks about you in class, by the way.
That's not why I'm here. Who decided on the zero, and was Owen heard before it went in?
He's one of the kindest kids I teach. He walked a new student around the building all through September.
Then you'll know what a zero in front of his class did to him. Kindness isn't what I asked about. What do you have besides the software?
A kid like that doesn't cheat out of malice. He was overwhelmed. We can both agree on that, right?
No, we can't. You've just told me he cheated and asked me to sign off on the reason. I've spent twenty years watching people get led into that, so show me a document or withdraw the zero.
